who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane blaze-command round six
what: The program's profile (opt level, backend, debuginfo, panic, instrumented flags), its code `Policy` and the walker's `Settings` are derived again in blaze-command: blaze-cargo's helpers that do this (serve/unit/codegen.rs and the profile reading) are private to blaze-cargo, which blaze-command does not depend on.
cost: two homes for one rule (rule 30); a profile key blaze-cargo learns and blaze-command does not is a key that misses an input
cause: the policy derivation lives in the crate that also runs cargo-shaped serving; no crate both take owns it
fix: one function in blaze-codegen (the crate that owns Policy; a new `plan/cargo.rs` beside the plans lane's plan.rs), over plain fields so it needs no blaze-units dependency: `pub fn profile_of(base: &CargoProfile<'_>, linked: &[CargoProfile<'_>], goal: Goal, macro_wasm: bool) -> Result<Profile, ProfileRefused>` with `CargoProfile { name, package, opt_level: &str, codegen_backend: Option<&str>, debuginfo: DebugInfo, panic: &str, overflow_checks, debug_assertions }`, and `pub fn instrumented(rustflags: &[String], triple: &str) -> Result<(Sanitize, Option<PgoAsk>), ProfileRefused>`; blaze-cargo's `serve/unit/codegen.rs::policy` and blaze-command's `graph::program_of` call them; ban the copies by name
